name: Sofie Linnea Bollen
bio: Sofie is a Master's student in Biotechnology at the University of Copenhagen. Her thesis investigates the potential PFAS-degrading capabilities of the cyanobacterium Microcystis aeruginosa, based on genomic evidence of positive selection for PFAS degradation linked to photosynthetic overcompensation and stress-coping mechanisms. In parallel, she aims to identify proteins interacting with PFOA through photocatalyst-mediated proximity labelling.
